info.name: Capella
info.description: Current Capella API: all 50 operations with saved examples. Set baseURL to your Laravel host (without /api), then register/login. Token and created resource IDs are captured automatically. Follow docs/postman.md for the sample workflow. Original collection and every historical example are preserved in docs/archive/Capella.before-modeling.postman_collection.json. New response examples are illustrative, not captured server responses. Do not run the whole collection indiscriminately: it includes deletion and logout requests. Project access is membership-based. Creators become admins. See docs/project-permissions.md. New membership examples use memberUsername and memberUserId. Historical saved examples remain unchanged. Layer roles: assign multiple fixed roles via roles arrays. See docs/project-permissions.md. New layer-role examples are listed before preserved historical responses.
